steps.title: Open the Data Manager
steps.narration: Let's check out the Data Manager — this is where Trendora keeps its price history current.
steps.point_out: The page loads cleanly with a form for starting a data job, and there's no 'service unavailable' message anywhere.

steps.title: Choose Fetch EOD prices
steps.narration: The job picker offers three clear choices — let's pick Fetch EOD prices to pull in the latest numbers.
steps.point_out: As soon as Fetch is selected, a source picker appears, already defaulted to a working, available data source.

steps.title: Start the Fetch job
steps.narration: One click starts the job, and now it refreshes the whole tracked company list instead of just a small slice of it.
steps.point_out: The progress panel shows the job working through 588 symbols in total — the entire tracked list, not the roughly 162 it used to cover.

steps.title: See the redesigned availability calendar
steps.narration: Scrolling down this same page, a daily calendar shows exactly what price data exists for every trading day.
steps.point_out: The legend is now split into two clearly labeled groups — a blue scale for how much price data exists, and a separate violet ring for whether a day has been fully scored — so the two ideas can never be confused, and hovering any day spells out the difference in plain words.

steps.title: Head to the Stock Leaderboard
steps.narration: Now let's head over to the Stocks page, home to every company Trendora tracks.
steps.point_out: The full leaderboard of 541 companies loads with real rankings, ready for the next check.

steps.title: Sort by Sector without a hitch
steps.narration: Clicking Sector re-orders the whole list by industry, instantly and cleanly.
steps.point_out: The table quietly re-sorts by industry, an arrow appears next to Sector, and the page never goes blank.

steps.title: Sort the other way, too
steps.narration: One more click reverses the order just as smoothly, confirming both directions work.
steps.point_out: The arrow flips the other way, and every leadership, entry-quality, and risk score still honestly reads 'Not yet proven' rather than overclaiming a result that hasn't been certified.

steps.title: Check the honest evidence ledger
steps.narration: Let's look at the Evidence page, where Trendora tracks which trading ideas have actually proven themselves.
steps.point_out: Every claim shows a clear pass or fail against a holdout test, and nothing is ever marked proven without genuinely earning it.

steps.title: Open a company's detail page
steps.narration: Opening a well-known company's own page shows just how deep its price history goes.
steps.point_out: NVIDIA's chart loads with over a thousand recent trading days ready to explore.

steps.title: Expand to full price history
steps.narration: Switching to full history stretches the same chart back across decades in one click.
steps.point_out: The bar count more than doubles and the chart still renders cleanly, with no errors and no blank space.
